cards.front: Anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis progresses from psychiatric symptoms to seizures, then [___] disorders, autonomic instability, and decreased consciousness.
cards.context:
Anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis is an autoimmune condition predominantly in young women, progressing in stages: psychiatric (psychosis, personality change) → seizures → movement di.

Diagnosis: anti-NMDA antibodies in CSF. ~50% of female cases have an ovarian teratoma — must screen. Treatment: immunotherapy (steroids, IVIG, plasmapheresis) and tumour removal.
